name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audits any website for AI-discoverability and on-site-engagement failures across five analysis gates, and emits an evidence-backed, prioritized audit report. Read-only and recommend-only: it never modifies the site it audits.

skills.role: Orchestrates the audit: preflight and safety checks, discovery and stratified sampling, the single polite crawl into the evidence ledger, fan-out to the six specialists, the eight-step merge, proactive recommendations, and the final verified report.

Gate G0, reach: whether a crawler is let in at all. robots.txt evaluated per AI agent, indexing and snippet directives, bot gating and challenge pages, sitemaps, redirect chains and canonical host duplication.

Gate G1, read: whether the page's text exists for a machine. Client-side render gaps detected in three tiers without requiring a browser, plus facts locked inside images, SVG, iframes, PDFs and video.

Gate G2, interpret: whether a machine knows what the facts mean. JSON-LD, Microdata and RDFa walked up an eight-rung validity ladder, profile-conditional property coverage, entity-graph linkage, and markup that contradicts the visible page.

Gates G2 to G3, identity and time: entity disambiguation posture, brand-name consistency across surfaces, sameAs corroboration, date coherence including build-time lastmod stamping, and the surface the site offers for third-party corroboration.

Gate G3, cite: whether a fact can be lifted and quoted. Passage self-containment under chunked retrieval, definitional statements, question-shaped coverage, fragment addressability and extractable fact structure.

Gate GE, engage: the deep, context-free arrival. Above-the-fold orientation, content-blocking friction, navigation and context retention computed over the crawled link graph, conversion path clarity and readability.
